title: CockroachDB schema jobs under load
brief: Treat CockroachDB schema changes as observable jobs within an application compatibility protocol.
outcomes: Interpret job progress, failure and cleanup
Accept a backfill or unique index only after semantic checks
entry: General schema migration, constraints and CockroachDB architecture.

heading.title: A changing schema
heading.brief: Explain online schema visibility and job phases on the pinned release; connect descriptor changes to old and new caller compatibility.

heading.title: A stored-column backfill
heading.brief: Build the shared order-line amount representation or covering index under writes; observe resource cost, progress and final value reconciliation.

heading.title: A failed unique index
heading.brief: Introduce duplicate proposed external references, inspect the failure and cleanup, correct the data and verify enforcement after successful retry.

heading.title: Acceptance and cancellation
heading.brief: Separate job success from application correctness; bound load and cancellation expectations and preserve a reversible caller state until acceptance.
